description: Afforestation/reforestation (A/R) experiment. Same as `scen7-vl-SST`, except land use is fixed at a present-day (2021) monthly climatology, and BVOC, fire and dust emissions are prescribed from `scen7-vl-SST`. Compare with `scen7-vl-SST` for the surface-albedo effect of A/R, and with `scen7-vl-SST-pdLU-BFD` for the effect via BVOC, fire and dust emissions.
